messages:
Jordan: Quick thread for the Helix migration POC. They see output deltas when switching from CompetitorX -> Redwood and raised presales blockers: prompt parity, tokenization truncation, security questionnaire, and POC pricing. Need a compact plan.
Maya: Can someone grab a couple of their specific divergent examples? helps us reproduce.
Jordan: They sent three short cases: 
1) 'Summarize this 1800-char legal clause into 5 bullets'
2) 'Email: apologize for delay, propose two next steps with owners'
3) 'Transform list into acceptance criteria with test cases'
Ravi: Security asks: KMS control, audit logs, data residency, and whether prompts are stored during Hosted trials. We should offer Private or Dedicated options and our security packet.
Lina: On the engineering side: common root causes are tokenizer differences (off-by-one truncation), role mapping mismatch, and sampling variance. Mitigations: canonicalize input, zero-temp for deterministic checks, and role-field mapping.
Jordan: Let's request a 30-sample eval set with expected outputs or pass/fail guidance. We'll run our eval harness and provide a diff report.
Maya: Also confirm tolerance: do they need exact string match or semantic similarity threshold (we usually recommend >=0.85 on embedding cosine or manual pass on 30 samples).
Ravi: Pricing for POC? Suggest: two-week Hosted credit up to 300k tokens + conversion incentive: credit applied to Dedicated commit if they convert within 45 days. Finance needs to bless the numbers.
Lina: I'll prepare a small compatibility shim snippet and an input normalization checklist. Example mapping: 
```n{"competitor": {"prompt":"...","role":"user"}, "redwood": {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}}
```
OpsBot: provisioned endpoint helix-parity-test-1796 (model=rwd-compat-3.2, retention=7d)
Jordan: Great. Action items: 1) Jordan -> ask Helix for eval set + acceptance criteria (today) 2) Maya -> run eval harness on helix-parity-test-1796 and upload diff (tomorrow) 3) Ravi -> prepare security pack & highlight KMS/private options (EOD) 4) Lina -> draft shim + normalization playbook (today) 5) Ops -> confirm Hosted credit promo and draft POC quote (today)
Maya: I'll also run deterministic runs (temp=0) and stochastic runs (temp=0.7) to show variance.
Ravi: Sending security packet now. Note: for Hosted POC we'll set retention to 7 days and can disable analytics sharing.
Jordan: Thanks team. Once Helix posts eval set I'll forward it here and we can triage the top divergences. :thumbsup:
